description: The smallest game whose round does NOT complete on the first response: `spin` always awards 2 free spins, so e8-server answers roundComplete:false / nextActions:['free_spin'] / spinsRemaining:2 and the round needs two `Step` calls to finish. Exists so the Step half of a round is drivable at all — `first-slot` completes every round on its first response.
note: Not read by e8-server or session-dev's tests — --games-dir loads .spin files directly. Descriptive metadata, same convention as engine/examples/first-slot/game/spec.json.
